preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxWalletAmount() with a very large _maxWalletAmountPct value (e.g., type(uint256).max) that will cause division to result in zero due to integer division. This will set maxWalletAmount to zero, effectively preventing any non-excluded wallet from holding any tokens, which could be used to trap user funds or disrupt normal token transfers.
